mapper.select: /** * searchComboBoxAprv : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.VacAprvMngMapper : 승인상태구분코드 조회 */ SELECT AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CD_VALUE , AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CD_NAME FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'APRV_STTS_SE_CD' AND AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN ('0','2','3')

/** * searchComboBoxVac : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.VacAprvMngMapper : 휴가구분코드 조회 */ SELECT AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CD_VALUE , AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CD_NAME FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'VCATN_SE_CD'

/** * selectVacAprvBatchList : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.VacAprvMngMapper : 일괄승인할 기간에 해당하는 List 조회 */ SELECT T1.COPA_INDEX_SN /* 상담파티색인일련번호 */ , T1.VCATN_APLY_YMD /* 휴가신청일자 */ , T1.VCATN_SE_CD /* 휴가구분코드 */ , T1.VCATN_BGNG_YMD /* 휴가시작일자 */ , T1.VCATN_END_YMD /* 휴가종료일자 */ , T1.APRV_STTS_SE_CD /* 승인상태구분코드 */ FROM AYC130 T1 /* 사이버1388휴가 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '0' AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND T1.VCATN_APLY_YMD >= TO_DATE(#{BGNG_YMD} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND T1.VCATN_APLY_YMD < TO_DATE(#{END_YMD} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
mapper.update: /** * deleteVacAprvMng : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.VacAprvMngMapper : 휴가승인관리 단건 삭제 */ UPDATE AYC130 AA SET AA.DEL_YN = 'Y' , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{loginId} , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND AA.COPA_INDEX_SN = #{indexSn} AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N'

/** * selectVacAprvMngSms : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.VacAprvMngMapper : 휴가 일괄 문자발송 조회 */ SELECT AA.COPA_INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN , AA.USER_ID AS USER_ID , AA.APRV_STTS_SE_CD AS APRV_STTS_SE_CD , AA.SMS_SNDNG_YN AS SMS_SNDNG_YN , ( SELECT REPLACE( A1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3, '{time}', substr(AA.VCATN_BGNG_YMD, 0, 4) || '-' || substr(AA.VCATN_BGNG_YMD, 5, 2) || '-' || substr(AA.VCATN_BGNG_YMD, 7, 2) || ' ~ ' || substr(AA.VCATN_END_YMD, 0, 4) || '-' || substr(AA.VCATN_END_YMD, 5, 2) || '-' || substr(AA.VCATN_END_YMD, 7, 2) ) FROM SAC100 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CHRCTR_ATMTC_SNDNG_SE_CD' AND A1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = DECODE(AA.APRV_STTS_SE_CD,'2','03','3','04') ) AS MSG_CONTENTS , '청소년상담 - 휴가신청 결과' AS MSG_SUBJECT , CC.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT AS CALL_TO FROM AYC130 AA /** 사이버1388휴가 **/ , SAA200 BB , SCA100 CC WHERE 1=1 AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.SMS_SNDNG_YN = 'N' AND AA.APRV_STTS_SE_CD IN ('2','3') AND AA.USER_ID = BB.USER_ID AND BB.ENFSN_NO = CC.ENFSN_NO
AND TO_DATE(AA.VCATN_APLY_YMD || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') >= TO_DATE(#{bgngYmd} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(AA.VCATN_APLY_YMD || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') < TO_DATE(#{endYmd} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1

SELECT ISRY_SMS.MMS_CONTENTS_INFO_SEQ.CURRVAL AS CONT_SEQ FROM DUAL
/** * insertVacAprvMngSms1 : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.VacAprvMngMapper : 휴가 일괄 문자발송 등록1 */ INSERT INTO ISRY_SMS.MMS_CONTENTS_INFO ( CONT_SEQ , FILE_CNT , MMS_SUBJECT , MMS_BODY ) VALUES ( ISRY_SMS.MMS_CONTENTS_INFO_SEQ.NEXTVAL , '1' , #{MSG_SUBJECT} , #{MSG_CONTENTS} )

/** * insertVacAprvMngSms2 : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.VacAprvMngMapper : 휴가 일괄 문자발송 등록2 */ INSERT INTO ISRY_SMS.MSG_DATA ( MSG_SEQ , REQ_DATE , CUR_STATE , CALL_TO , CALL_FROM , MSG_TYPE , USER_ID , CONT_SEQ ) VALUES ( ISRY_SMS.MSG_DATA_SEQ.NEXTVAL , SYSDATE , '0' , #{CALL_TO} , '0516623229' , '6' , #{loginId} , #{CONT_SEQ} )
mapper.update: /** * insertVacAprvMngSms3 : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.VacAprvMngMapper : 휴가 일괄 문자발송 수정3 */ UPDATE AYC130 AA /**사이버1388휴가**/ SET AA.SMS_SNDNG_YN = 'Y' , AA.SNDNG_DT = SYSDATE , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{loginId} , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND AA.COPA_INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}
